posts.text:
Today, I spoke to leaders of @KyElectricCoops as they convened in DC.

I updated them on what I've been working on in Congress, and they thanked me for voting for the SPEED Act and PERMIT Act—both of which passed the House.

Thank you for keeping the lights on in Kentucky!

If we’re Making America Healthy Again, government shouldn't be promoting glyphosate and providing liability immunity for corporations making it.

Thank you to @RepEliCrane for cosponsoring the No Immunity for Glyphosate Act.

Recently, I met with a group of homeschooled students from the 4th District.

The students meet once a week for a Life & Leadership class, and their instructor, Ms. Kate Iadipaolo, invited me to speak to them about leadership & civics. 

I enjoyed our discussion.

I spoke in front of the Supreme Court to oppose a case that would give legal immunity to pesticides.

And this evening I cosponsored an amendment with @chelliepingree to strip similar immunity from the Farm Bill.

My PRIME Act is in the Farm Bill, so I’m trying to clean it up.


LindellTV (@RealLindellTV)

🚨 EXCLUSIVE: Rep. Thomas Massie Sounds the Alarm on Glyphosate Immunity 🚨

Our own @CaraCastronuova interviewed @RepThomasMassie - and what he revealed should have every American paying attent

Recently, I spoke with The New American to review what’s still missing from the Epstein Files. My interview begins at the 8:56 mark in this YouTube video.
piped.video/watch?v=4MfGmV…

I spoke at "The People vs. Poison Rally" outside the Supreme Court this morning. 

I talked about the "No Immunity for Glyphosate Act," which I co-authored with @chelliepingree. Corporations should not be shielded from accountability, and Americans deserve their day in court.
I will be at the United States Supreme Court today to speak at "The People vs. Poison Rally." My remarks will begin at 9:30 AM. Tune in! nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1XxygmLpZ…

Automobile kill-switches are coming soon to car dealerships near you.

I teamed up w/ Scott Perry & Chip Roy to defund this Orwellian mandate, but too many colleagues (Republican & Democrat) voted against us, so the federal mandate for every new car after 2026 is still in place.


Thomas Massie (@RepThomasMassie)

Federal law says new cars after 2026 must monitor drivers and shut down if the car disapproves. Your dashboard should not be judge, jury, and executioner.

@RepScottPerry @RepC

Thank you to the Secret Service and law enforcement for protecting our President and acting quickly to subdue the shooter.

There is no room in our country for political violence.
thehill.com/homenews/adminis…

Would you believe 57 Republicans and 211 Democrats recently voted in favor of this Orwellian automobile kill-switch? Here’s the roll call for the vote I forced to defund the mandate: clerk.house.gov/evs/2026/rol…


Pubity (@pubity)

Every new car in the U.S. will be required by law to have tech that puts constant surveillance on the driver by 2027.

AI in your car will determine if you're sober and fit to drive, automatically turning off the vehicle if it determines you're a danger on the road.

I ended yesterday afternoon with @SenRandPaul at @PHARMCBD in Bedford.

We toured the facility, held a roundtable discussion with local officials & hemp producers, and heard first-hand testimony from families & veterans who have benefitted medically from hemp-derived products.

Today,@SenRandPaul and I visited the beautiful @YewDellGardens in Crestwood for a meet & greet organized by the Oldham County Chamber of Commerce.

I discussed my current legislation and reminded those present that my voting card belongs to them—the people of the 4th District.

.@SenRandPaul and I just held a local leadership luncheon/round table at the Spencer County Extension Office in Taylorsville.

We discussed federal priorities, and local officials asked great questions, including about federal spending cuts and AI data centers.

Spectrum News’ @ErinKYSpectrum reports on the Surveillance Accountability Act that @RepBoebert and I introduced. It would override the flawed 3rd Party Doctrine that the government uses to justify spying on Americans’ private records without a warrant.
spectrumnews1.com/ky/louisvi…

This week, I met with representatives of @KentuckyBev.

We discussed supporting Kentucky’s beverage industry and the thousands of Kentuckians who produce, market, and distribute non-alcoholic beverages across the Commonwealth.

✅ 1/20/25 Republicans took control of White House + Senate + House.

❌They expanded spending beyond Biden’s budget, causing U.S. debt to increase $2.7 trillion since then.

👎I voted against this excessive spending and that’s why the swamp wants me gone.

👍I keep my promises!
